types.name: orderbook.v1.Depth
types.doc: Depth specifies the number of price levels per side.

values.name: DEPTH_1
values.doc: 1 level per side (top of book / best bid-ask).

types.name: orderbook.v1.GetOrderBookRequest
types.doc: GetOrderBookRequest describes a ConnectRPC snapshot request.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Stable numeric pair ID from GetSpotConfig.

fields.name: depth
fields.doc: Requested depth per side (number of price levels). Default is 50.

types.name: orderbook.v1.GetOrderBookResponse
types.doc:
GetOrderBookResponse is a depth snapshot for the binary (protobuf) API (scaled integers).
 REST surfaces expose decimal strings via DTO conversion. A configured symbol
 whose book is being built, or was invalidated, returns a successful snapshot
 with available false and no levels: its book is unknown, not empty. Read
 available before treating empty sides as no liquidity.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Numeric symbol identifier (client resolves to symbol string).

fields.name: book_seq
fields.doc: Monotonic book sequence for this symbol.

fields.name: bids
fields.doc:
Best bid first; descending price. When available is true, empty means no
 current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

fields.name: asks
fields.doc:
Best ask first; ascending price. When available is true, empty means no
 current liquidity; when it is false, always empty.

fields.name: available
fields.doc:
True when the book is current: bids and asks are its levels, and empty
 sides mean no liquidity. False while the book is being built or after it
 was invalidated: its levels are unknown, not empty, and the response
 carries none. Request the snapshot again later.

types.name: orderbook.v1.OrderBookDelta
types.doc:
OrderBookDelta is an incremental update to the orderbook state of one depth
 tier: the difference between two published views of the tier's top levels
 per side. Uses scaled integers (binary protobuf) for realtime streaming
 performance.

 Semantics:
 - For each side, each [price_ticks] entry is a SET at that price:
   - qty_scaled > 0 => set/replace that level quantity
   - qty_scaled == 0 => remove that level from the tier's view
 - reset=true indicates the book should be cleared before applying any levels.
   A reset carrying the full view is sent periodically, currently about every
   30 seconds, and after a sequence gap.

 To start, subscribe, then fetch GetOrderBook with the tier's depth. Drop
 deltas whose book_seq_end is at most the snapshot's book_seq, and apply the
 first delta only when its book_seq_start equals that book_seq; then apply
 each delta only when its book_seq_start equals the previous book_seq_end.
 Otherwise, or after a gap, wait for the next reset.

fields.name: book_seq_start
fields.doc:
Book sequence of the view this update applies to: the previous update's
 book_seq_end. Apply it only to a book at exactly this sequence. 0 when
 reset=true.

fields.name: book_seq_end
fields.doc:
Book sequence of the view after this update. It can advance without any
 change to the book. Consumers can retain it as the last applied sequence
 and ignore updates that do not advance it.

fields.name: reset
fields.doc:
If true, consumers should clear their local book state before applying
 updates.

types.name: orderbook.v1.PriceLevel
types.doc:
PriceLevel uses scaled integers for the binary (protobuf) API (low-latency).
 REST surfaces expose decimal strings via DTO conversion.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Price in quote units scaled by 1e9.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc: Quantity scaled by the pair's base_quantity_scale from GetSpotConfig.
